prediction_interval.meaning: Sampling uncertainty of the fitted model only.

weighted_sensitivity_at_default_horizon.note: Cross-sectional adult weights of baseline waves 1-2 only; later waves have no weights in the supplied files; attrition handled by IPCW, not weights.

former.selection_rule: Greedy forward selection of input groups by validation interval-censored log-likelihood (gain threshold in config), then ridge and time-varying-effect penalties by validation (proportional hazards stays a candidate). Horizons shown only if validation Brier beats a no-input baseline. Final refit on all non-test people; calibration shift and slope from out-of-fold predictions; test evaluated once after all decisions.
former.censoring_assumption: Interval-censored likelihood assumes loss to follow-up is noninformative given the inputs. IPCW weights use baseline-wave-stratified loss curves; returns whose interval straddles the horizon are unresolved. Fitting counts every baseline row equally; evaluation gives each person total weight one.
former.calibration_method: Log-hazard shift and slope fitted by maximum likelihood on 5-fold out-of-fold predictions (folds by person) over all non-test participants.
